correctness.rationale: The projector preserves means, and the minimum-norm lift of a difference vector u is D^T(DD^T)^(-1)u. Thus the induced problem is an H-metric projection onto the ℓ1 ball for H=(DD^T)^(-1). On a signed support J, fixing all other coordinates to zero and enforcing s^Tz_J=τ gives the stated affine derivative; strict off-support KKT slack makes the chosen face cell locally full-dimensional. The inverse principal Green matrix has the gap-conductance Laplacian form by eliminating the unselected nodes. Green-kernel linearity gives nonnegative interpolation columns of total mass at most one; the entries of Bs align with s, so ||Bs||_1=s^TBs. Dividing the rank-one correction by this positive denominator gives a column bound of two. Piecewise affinity and continuity extend the slope bound across cell boundaries. Scalar clipping and the two displayed 2×2 full-support cases, with zero singleton derivative, give the upper bound one for n=2,3. In n≥4 the full ascending face has correction supported on the two end edges, so shifting one interior input difference by ε yields output difference εe_k−(ε/2)(e_1+e_m); the residual multipliers 1 and 1+ε/2 certify the claimed projections. The two ratios are attained in the interior for low n and by this pair scaled to any τ>0 for high n. Radius zero yields zero modulus as stated. Replay: frozen RESULT.md §§1–6. The provided rational checker was inspected, not run; finite face enumeration is a supplement, not the all-dimensional proof.
